title: Member Appeals Program Status from Plan Enrollment to Closure
content:
A member's Member Appeals Program follows the member's plan enrollment. It opens with the enrollment and takes effect on the enrollment's effective date. When coverage ends it enters runout, and it stays in runout for the package's runout period so that denials from covered dates can still be appealed. After that it closes. Every change of status below is made by the system.

## Statuses

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Pending effective | The program has been opened with the plan enrollment, under the appeal package the sponsor elected, and the plan coverage effective date has not yet been reached. |
| Active | Plan coverage is in effect and appeal rights apply. |
| Runout | Plan coverage has ended. Denials from covered dates stay appealable. |
| Closed | The program has ended. |

## Changes of status

| From | To | What brings it about | End date shown on the program |
|---|---|---|---|
| Pending effective | Active | Plan coverage takes effect and appeal rights apply | Not set by this change |
| Pending effective | Closed | The future-dated plan enrollment is cancelled before it takes effect | The day before the cancelled effective date |
| Active | Runout | Plan coverage ends | The last day of plan coverage |
| Runout | Active | A COBRA reinstatement restores coverage | Cleared, because coverage continues |
| Runout | Closed | The runout period ends | Unchanged: the last day of coverage |

## Illustrations (hypothetical dates)

- **Coverage ends.** Plan coverage ends on 31 March. The program moves from active to runout, with 31 March as its end date. During runout, a denial from a covered date such as 10 March can still be appealed.
- **COBRA reinstatement.** While the program is in runout, a COBRA reinstatement restores coverage. The program returns to active and its end date is cleared.
- **Cancelled before it starts.** A plan enrollment due to take effect on 1 July is cancelled before that date. The program closes with 30 June as its end date.
